Holdings: Reading Railroad, Electric Company, St James Place (2 houses), Tennessee Avenue (2 houses), New York Avenue (2 houses). No mortgaged properties. Others: Beta has 640 cash, owns Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois (all orange? Actually Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois are red? Wait: Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois are red? Bank houses remaining 18, hotels 12. Buildable spaces: St James Place (yellow? Actually St James Place is orange? Wait: St. James Place is orange? Potential actions: build houses/hotel, mortgage property, end turn. They could also trade, but trade is not an action here; it's just allowed later? The options include can_trade_with but not an action type. So only build, mortgage, end turn.

Goal: maximize long-term advantage. They have a monopoly with 2 houses each, generating rent. Building more houses increases rent significantly. With cash 280, they could build 2 houses (cost $200) on any two properties, or 1 house on each (cost $300) which they can't afford. They could also build a hotel on a property if they have 4 houses already, but they have only 2 each. So best is to add houses.

Which property yields best ROI? Rent values: For orange set with 2 houses: St James Place rent $550? Next New York (+350), then Tennessee (+320). So allocate houses to maximize rent increase per dollar: all $100 houses same cost, but St James gives highest increase. So we should add houses to St James first, then New York, then Tennessee.

We have $280, can add 2 houses to St James (cost $200) and 1 house to New York (cost $100) total $300 > 280. So maybe 2 houses to St James ($200) and 1 house to Tennessee ($100) = $300 > 280. So we can only afford 2 houses total. Options: add 2 houses to St James (cost $200) leaving $80 cash. Or add 1 house to each of two properties (cost $200) leaving $80. Which yields higher rent increase? Option A: add 2 houses to St James: from 2 to 4 houses, rent increase: from 220 to 800 (+580). Option B: add 1 house to St James (+380) and 1 house to New York (+350) total +730 for $200. That's better. Option C: St James + Tennessee: +380 +320 = +700. So best is St James + New York.

Thus build 1 house on St James Place and 1 house on New York Avenue. That uses $200, leaving cash 80.

We could also consider building a hotel later but need 4 houses first. Not possible now.

Mortgage? Could mortgage Electric Company or Reading Railroad for cash. Mortgage values: Reading Railroad mortgage value $100? Actually mortgage value of railroads is $100. Thus best action: build houses on St James Place and New York Avenue (1 each). Use build_houses_or_hotel tool.
